scenarios.title: Normal conversation
scenarios.expected_behavior: ordered terminal response and persisted assistant message

scenarios.title: Conversation isolation
scenarios.expected_behavior: no message, goal, or action crosses conversations
scenarios.verification_method: compare conversation IDs, histories, goals, and action IDs

scenarios.title: Natural-language goal routing
scenarios.expected_behavior: intent routes to a safe canonical goal plan

scenarios.title: Ambiguous action request
preconditions: multiple resumable targets or missing target
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarification or safe block with zero mutation
scenarios.verification_method: assert clarification and no mutating action

scenarios.title: Persistent memory after restart
scenarios.expected_behavior: fact and provenance survive restart

scenarios.title: ProjectBrain context retrieval
scenarios.expected_behavior: bounded relevant project evidence is returned

scenarios.title: Relevant context without pollution
scenarios.expected_behavior: relevant context is selected and unrelated memory excluded

scenarios.title: Multiple conversation memory isolation
scenarios.expected_behavior: conversation-scoped state does not leak

scenarios.title: Filesystem read
scenarios.expected_behavior: exact content is returned and path remains bounded

scenarios.title: Filesystem write and exact readback
scenarios.expected_behavior: one confirmed write reaches completed_verified with exact bytes

scenarios.title: Git-safe status observation
scenarios.expected_behavior: structured observation without mutation
scenarios.verification_method: compare bounded result with porcelain status

scenarios.title: Workspace escape rejected
scenarios.trigger_input: read or write outside allowed root
scenarios.expected_behavior: path validation rejects request before mutation
scenarios.verification_method: assert structured rejection and unchanged external target

scenarios.title: Natural-language planning to completion
scenarios.expected_behavior: canonical plan, confirmation, execution, verification

scenarios.title: Malformed structured planner output
scenarios.expected_behavior: bounded repair or PLAN_INVALID with zero unsafe action
scenarios.verification_method: strict schema and bounded repair tests

scenarios.title: Anti-spin and no progress
scenarios.expected_behavior: bounded failure within hard replan and step limits
scenarios.verification_method: assert terminal block and bounded counters

scenarios.title: Repeated equivalent goal
scenarios.expected_behavior: new bounded goal; prior action is not replayed

scenarios.title: No fake success
scenarios.trigger_input: execute action whose acceptance criterion fails
scenarios.expected_behavior: never report completed_verified
scenarios.verification_method: assert terminal status, evidence, and journal

scenarios.title: Confirmation approve
scenarios.expected_behavior: mutation executes once and verifies
scenarios.verification_method: exact effect and single-use token assertion

scenarios.title: Confirmation refuse
scenarios.expected_behavior: goal pauses and no mutation occurs
scenarios.verification_method: assert target absent and journal refusal

scenarios.title: Confirmation expiry and stale rejection
scenarios.expected_behavior: invalid_confirmation and no action
scenarios.verification_method: assert structured error and unchanged target

scenarios.title: Rollback after failed verification
scenarios.expected_behavior: original state restored and goal blocked

scenarios.title: Pause and resume
scenarios.expected_behavior: continue from checkpoint without replay

scenarios.title: Cancel
scenarios.expected_behavior: terminal cancelled state and no later action

scenarios.title: Restart recovery
scenarios.trigger_input: reopen stores after simulated process restart
scenarios.expected_behavior: uncertain work pauses safely and completed steps remain checkpointed
scenarios.verification_method: reopen persistent stores and inspect state

scenarios.title: No replay after restart
scenarios.expected_behavior: terminal mutation is never replayed
scenarios.verification_method: compare action IDs and exact filesystem effect

scenarios.title: UIA inspect
scenarios.expected_behavior: semantic tree identifies owned editable control

scenarios.title: UIA action and verification
scenarios.expected_behavior: intended control changes and verification matches

scenarios.title: Stale UIA reference recovery
scenarios.expected_behavior: reject stale reference, re-inspect, then safely recover
scenarios.verification_method: REAL-15 fixture diagnostics and before/after evidence

scenarios.title: Ambiguous UIA target fails closed
scenarios.expected_behavior: structured ambiguity error and zero mutation

scenarios.title: Ten-goal endurance sequence
scenarios.expected_behavior: 10 of 10 completed_verified

scenarios.title: Endurance state isolation
scenarios.trigger_input: inspect state, journal, and action IDs
scenarios.expected_behavior: no leak, duplicate, replay, stuck presence, or journal inconsistency

scenarios.title: Single-use confirmation under repetition
scenarios.expected_behavior: one mutation only; stale token rejected
scenarios.verification_method: reuse validated Phase 4 REAL-18 plus targeted test

scenarios.title: Provider fallback
scenarios.expected_behavior: one bounded fallback succeeds
scenarios.verification_method: provider routing test and sanitized diagnostics

scenarios.title: Provider unavailable
scenarios.expected_behavior: explicit provider_unavailable with no fake result

scenarios.title: Visual provider degraded path
scenarios.expected_behavior: sanitized unavailability and no fabricated observation

scenarios.title: Malformed goal payload
scenarios.expected_behavior: structured validation error and zero execution

scenarios.title: Missing structured planner
scenarios.expected_behavior: explicit safe error and zero actions

scenarios.title: Malformed or stale visual input
scenarios.expected_behavior: structured error before provider materialization
scenarios.verification_method: stale image and window reference tests
